stories.headline: The Law Rides Into Green Bay: Jacobs Banished to the Sidelines
stories.read: Well pardner, the league just put Josh Jacobs on the commissioner's exempt list, and that bell-cow can't so much as touch a practice field till further notice. That's your RB1 turned into a hitching post overnight, and the fellas who slept through the news are still carrying dead weight on their roster. MarShawn Lloyd just inherited the whole herd in Green Bay, and he's sitting there unclaimed on the open range right now, free for whoever stakes it first. Go pan that creek before your leaguemates wake up.

stories.headline: A.J. Brown Laid Up Six Weeks — Patriots Pass-Catchers Just Got Richer
stories.read: Brown took a bad spill on a third-down grab up in New England, and the word from the wire says a high ankle sprain lands him on injured reserve for six weeks minimum, no surgery needed. That's a hard blow if he's anchoring your receiving corps, but don't just cut bait, every other Patriot who runs a route just picked up a bigger cut of the throws while he's laid up. Somebody in that offense is fixin' to strike gold these next six weeks, and the smart money starts diggin' now, not in Week 8 when he's back.

stories.headline: Bowers Takes a Knee Trim, Mayer Rides Into the Money Patch
stories.read: Raiders' big tight end went under the knife for a meniscus trim, and he's out a game or two while it heals, no long-term worry but a real hole in your lineup this week. Michael Mayer steps into the starter's saddle in the meantime, and while he hasn't hit paydirt much with Bowers healthy, an every-down role in the money patch makes him a legit streaming play for the next couple Sundays. Rent that horse for a ride or two, then hand the reins right back once Bowers is fit.
